articles.title: SpaceX stock is coming to Solana on the same day it lists on Nasdaq

articles.title: Hungary to reverse crypto trading crackdown after EU scrutiny
articles.snippet: Hungary’s government said it will unwind crypto trading restrictions that required approved validation for conversions and exposed users and service providers to criminal liability.

articles.title: XRP transaction demand falls 91.5% as traders focus on $0.65 support
